help_admin:
🛡 For admins:
/gban — ban in all chats where the bot is present (/gban @username/userid 1m/1h/1d/1w/1mo reason)
/sban — silent ban ONLY in the current chat (/sban @username/userid 1m/1h/1d/1w/1mo reason)
/sgban — silent ban in all chats where the bot is present (/sgban @username/userid 1m/1h/1d/1w/1mo reason)
/ungban — unban in all chats with the bot (/unsgban @username/userid 1m/1h/1d/1w/1mo reason)
/unsban — silent unban in the current chat (/unsban @username/userid 1m/1h/1d/1w/1mo reason)
/unsgban — silent unban in all chats where the bot is present (/unsgban @username/userid 1m/1h/1d/1w/1mo reason)
/sdelete_user - silently delete a user's messages (/sdelete_user @username/userid 1m/1h/1d or a message count (c200 - delete the user's last 200 messages)) 
/delete_chat - delete messages in the chat (from all users) for a specific period of time (/delete_chat 1m/1h/1d or a message count (c200 - delete the user's last 200 messages)) 
/sdelete_chat — clear all messages in the chat for a period (/sdelete_chat 1m/1h/1d or a message count (c200 - delete the user's last 200 messages)), /sdelete_chat — silently clear all messages in the chat for a period (1h, 1d) or the last N messages (c200 - 200 messages)
/gmute, /smute, /gsmute — global / silent / silent global mute
/ungmute, /unsmute, /ungsmute — the corresponding unmute
/raid_on — enable anti-raid: ban all new members
/raid_off — disable anti-raid
/add_adm, /del_adm — grant/remove admin
/add_mod, /del_mod — grant/remove moderator
/admin — admin panel (in DM with the bot)
Global commands (/gban, /sgban, /gmute, etc.) can also be sent in DM to the bot.
Instead of specifying a target for punishment (or, conversely, for lifting one), you can reply to the user's message instead of typing @username/userid (example: as a reply to a message from @username: /mute 1d bad person)
help_mod:
🔨 Moderation (moderators and above):
/ban — ban in this chat (/ban @username/userid 1m/1h/1d/1w/1mo reason)
/unban — unban in this chat (/unban @username/userid 1m/1h/1d/1w/1mo reason)
/mute — mute (/mute @username/userid 1m/1h/1d/1w/1mo reason)
/unmute — unmute (/unmute @username/userid 1m/1h/1d/1w/1mo reason)
/delete — delete the message you're replying to
/delete_user — delete a user's messages (/delete_user @username/userid 1m/1h/1d or a message count (c200 - delete the user's last 200 messages))
/punl — a user's punishment history
